scope: Public primary sources only; no market-data APIs.

sources.title: Individual pricing
sources.claim: Basic advertises 8/minute and 800/day with a non-display label. Grow advertises internal display; the displayed 377-credit option is USD 79/month.
sources.implication: Scope each intended use separately; Basic UK/India coverage and Grow NAV are not proven.

sources.title: Terms of use; updated 1 January 2026
sources.claim: Tier, third-party and permitted-retention restrictions apply.
sources.implication: Obtain scoped evidence before activation; a plan label is not a full training licence.

sources.title: Credits; dated 16 October 2025
sources.claim: Credits use endpoint weight multiplied by symbols. Basic daily allowance resets at 00:00 UTC.
sources.implication: Reserve shared minute/day quotas atomically and account for weighted batches.

sources.title: yfinance project documentation
sources.claim: The project distinguishes its software from Yahoo data rights and disclaims Yahoo affiliation.
sources.implication: The software licence does not grant rights to market data.

sources.title: Apple investor FAQ
sources.claim: Apple states that AAPL trades on Nasdaq.
sources.implication: Use as identity evidence only; no observed quote or personal holding is claimed.

sources.title: Vodafone holding announcement;21 October 2026
sources.claim: The LSE announcement identifies Vodafone and ISIN GB 00 BH 4 HKS 39.
sources.implication: Verify the provider quote unit separately; the GBX fixture mapping is explicit and simulated.

sources.title: Reliance integrated filing;30 October 2026
sources.claim: The filing lists RELIANCE, ISIN INE 002 A 01018 and INR presentation currency.
sources.implication: Use as India identity evidence only; provider mapping and use grants remain pending.

sources.title: NAV disclosure time-limit circular
sources.claim: NAV valuation date and publication can differ for overseas schemes.
sources.implication: Use a per-fund publication policy rather than one universal deadline.

sources.title: Batch API requests
sources.claim: Each symbol consumes its endpoint weight even in one HTTP batch.
sources.implication: Three weight-one symbols need three credits.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance data-usage help
sources.claim: The help fetch returned 429 and the terms fetch returned 999 in this pass.
sources.implication: No Yahoo data-use grant was verified from these failed reads.

sources.title: Individual pricing (Grow credit options), read by the MP-10 research
sources.claim: Grow 55 is the 55-credit Grow option at USD 29 a month with no daily cap; Grow is labelled internal display, view-only; LSE, NSE and BSE are end of day on Grow; fund NAV plan coverage is contradictory across the public pages.
sources.implication: Grow 55 selected by the owner (2 Nov 2026); rights rest on OWNER-RISK-01, not a grant; UK fund NAVs are tested in the first month.

sources.title: Yahoo Terms of Service, updated 1 November 2026, read by the MP-10 research
sources.claim: Collecting data by any automated means without express permission is forbidden (s2(d)(ix)).
sources.implication: Supersedes the failed read in RES-DATA-10; Yahoo use rests on OWNER-RISK-01.

sources.title: Dividends and splits endpoint documentation, read by the MP-10 research
sources.claim: /dividends and /splits weigh 20 credits per symbol and need Grow or above; /last_change weighs 1 per request.
sources.implication: Corrects DATA-07: a full daily action check is 40 credits per listing and Basic makes none.

updated: 2026-11-03: RES-DATA-11 to 13 added from the MP-10 research for the MP-20 consolidation; nothing fetched again.
